# B1 Python manifest fixtures

These two tiny text fixtures are team-authored inputs used by the independent
tests. The tests place their bytes into an in-memory ZIP before handing the
archive to the real A2 read-only ingestion session.

The files contain no third-party text, credentials, network resource, or
executable target code. They are original project test material and are
distributed under the OpenGuard project's Apache-2.0 license. No binary
fixture, package download, installation, or external service is required.
